candidates.change_summary: Delete the assignment of the guess hash, leaving guesses[msg.sender].guess as bytes32(0).
Delete the assignment of the target block, leaving guesses[msg.sender].block at 0.
Delete the require that prevents locking a guess twice.
Invert the guard so a guess can only be re-locked when one already exists.
Set the target block to block.number instead of block.number + 1.
Remove the statement resetting guesses[msg.sender].block to 0, allowing repeated settling of the same guess.
Compute the answer directly from blockhash without keccak256, changing which guesses win the payout.
Invert the win condition from equality to inequality, so losers are paid and winners are not.
Change the payout amount from 2 ether to 1 ether, altering the ether balance observable after settling a winning guess.
Make the win condition always true so every settle pays out 2 ether.
